body: Orchestrator (DM-184 review) — candidate for the retro, pre-existing on main: import overwrites an existing report's content from run.json without re-checking its content hash (src/core/repo/importer.ts `ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET content_json = excluded.content_json`; portable.ts `contentHash: opaqueHash`). A hand-edited retro can replace an approved report on another machine, defeating the local approval binding to report_hash. Recommended fix: refuse changed content for an existing report id and recompute the hash for reports that carry a scorecard.
